## 🏆 Signature Projects & Impact (STAR Formula)

### 1. Aplikasi Operasional Kantor Notaris & PPAT (irwan-baddu)
- **Context:** Core operational system for Notary & PPAT Irwan Baddu handling 7-stage deed processing, automatic reporting, and escrow tax compliance.
- **Action:** Engineered architecture using Laravel 13 and Svelte 5 (Runes), automated the 7-stage deed lifecycle, integrated automatic bookkeeping for Repertorium and Klapper books, and enforced financial segregation between office operational cash accounts and state tax escrow accounts (PPh & BPHTB with validated NTPN codes).
- **Impact:** 100% elimination of double data entry; zero discrepancy in tax escrow auditing; 60% reduction in draft deed preparation cycle time.
- **Stack:** Laravel 13, Svelte 5 (Runes), Tailwind CSS v4, MySQL 3NF, NTPN Validation, PHPUnit.
- **Repository:** Private Client System (Internal Production Architecture)

### 2. SIM-PQTM: Sistem Manajemen Pendidikan Yayasan & Rapor Digital (yayasan-pqtm)
- **Context:** Centralized institutional management platform for Yayasan Pondok Quran Terpadu Malang across 3 educational units (Santri Boarding, LTQ, and PKBM Kurikulum Merdeka).
- **Action:** Built web system with bulk daily student attendance logging, Quran memorization mutaba'ah tracking, automated grade calculation based on learning outcomes, and in-browser official report card printing.
- **Impact:** Daily mass attendance logging reduced to <2 minutes; instant report card printing compliant with Kemendikbud standards; zero external PDF licensing cost.
- **Stack:** Laravel, Svelte 5, MySQL, Kurikulum Merdeka Standards, Browser Print Engine.
- **Repository:** Private Client System (Internal Production Architecture)

### 3. Twinnie Group: Ekosistem Web Layanan Kesehatan Integratif (twinnie-group)
- **Context:** High-performance web platform for integrative family healthcare in Malang Raya (Baby Spa, Traditional Chinese Medicine/Acupuncture, Psychology, and Sharia Partnership).
- **Action:** Developed purely static, high-performance web architecture without heavy runtime server compilers, achieving sub-second load times (<1.0s), full WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility, and reactive WhatsApp booking deep-linking.
- **Impact:** Sub-second First Contentful Paint (<1.0s) on mobile 4G networks; 100% zero silent failure booking flow; scalable static hosting with zero server licensing overhead.
- **Stack:** Semantic HTML5, Modular Vanilla JS, Tailwind CSS, WCAG 2.1 AA, JSON-LD Schema.
- **Live Platform:** [twinniegroup.com](https://twinniegroup.com) | **Repository:** [github.com/misbahudin98/twinnie-group](https://github.com/misbahudin98/twinnie-group)

### 4. Sistem Informasi PPDB Terpusat & Multi-Campus Notification Gateway
- **Context:** Centralized new student admission platform spanning 5 educational tiers (Baby School, TK, SD, SMP, SMA) at Ar-Rohmah Putri.
- **Action:** Built secure RESTful API backend powered by Laravel Passport (OAuth 2.0) and MySQL; designed automated WhatsApp & Email notification gateways for multi-stage verification and payment confirmation.
- **Impact:** Scaled to manage >10,000 registered applicant & student accounts; 70% reduction in document verification latency; 99.8% notification gateway uptime.
- **Stack:** Laravel Passport, OAuth 2.0, MySQL Schema, WhatsApp Gateway, SMTP Email.

### 5. Buku Induk Santri & Pipeline Migrasi 12.117 Record (Zero Data Loss)
- **Context:** Database modernization eliminating years of fragmented and conflicting student/staff records from legacy SQL and Excel dumps.
- **Action:** Formulated automated ETL extraction, deduplication, and anomaly cleansing pipeline into a normalized 3NF MySQL schema based on NIS Yayasan (NISY).
- **Impact:** 12,117 records (9,312 historical students, 800 applicants, 2,005 staff) migrated with 100% integrity (zero data loss); resolved all historical accounting and public relations record discrepancies.
- **Stack:** ETL Scripting, Data Cleansing, MySQL 3NF, NISY Architecture.

### 6. Aplikasi Kepegawaian & Digital Workflow Automation (SIM-SDM)
- **Context:** Institutional HR lifecycle management digitizing paper-based bureaucracy for 2,005 active employees.
- **Action:** Developed centralized web interface with digital forms and multi-level approval workflows for leave, study permits, status changes, contract renewals, and terminations.
- **Impact:** 85% paperless HR operations; leave approval turnaround reduced to <24 hours.
- **Stack:** PHP, jQuery, MySQL, Tailwind CSS, Digital Approval Engine.

## 🔄 Data Architecture & ETL Codex: Data Engineering vs Data Analysis
- **Mental Model:** *"Data Engineer builds the pipeline and water treatment infrastructure; Data Analyst formulates the nutrition and serves the drink for business consumption."*
- **Data Engineering Perspective (Pipeline, Scale, & Reliability):**
  - **Extract:** Memory-safe chunk streaming (`Chunking 500 rows`, continuous RAM consumption $\le 32\text{MB}$), Change Data Capture (CDC), zero-lock ingestion.
  - **Transform:** Third Normal Form (3NF) relational normalization, formula injection mitigation (CWE-1236), strict schema casting.
  - **Load:** Transactional atomic inserts wrapped in `DB::transaction()` with automatic rollback, Slowly Changing Dimensions (SCD Type 1/2), and SHA-256 dual-checksum reconciliation (12,117 / 12,117 records verified with 100% match and zero data loss).
- **Data Analysis Perspective (Business Semantics, Metrics, & Delivery):**
  - **Extract / Discovery:** Single Source of Truth (SSoT) audit, eliminating semantic discrepancies between operational departments (e.g. Humas vs Finance).
  - **Transform / Modeling:** Dimensional Star Schema (`dim_santri`, `dim_waktu`, `fact_pembayaran`), formal metric calculations (MoM, YoY, cohort retention), and business logic data cleansing.
  - **Load / BI Delivery:** Aggregated data mart generation for sub-2-second executive dashboards, high data-to-ink ratio visualization, and actionable strategic insights.
- **Full Architecture Specification:** Documented in [`docs/etl_data_engineering_vs_data_analysis.md`](docs/etl_data_engineering_vs_data_analysis.md).
